title: Web chat workspace
responsibility: Keeps the web conversation on the explorer’s project and routes its unit references to that project’s history.

inputs.name: createConsoleWorkspaceStore.navigate
inputs.description: A navigation callback supplied to the factory; the workspace calls it from onNavigate with a leading /harness prefix removed and replace set to the inverse of push.

outputs.name: createConsoleWorkspaceStore
outputs.description: The factory returns { workspace, close }, where workspace is the store from createWorkspaceStore() and close invokes the bridge adapter's close(). It disables routeProject, connects with local: false, rewrites only modules, module-resources, and permissions routes to the pages category while retaining branch and commit, and strips a leading /harness and inverts push in onNavigate.
